name: Rebuild site, building and storeys from AVEVA object names
description: Merges the sites and buildings into one of each, replaces the storeys with one per level the objects' names give (named 0J … 80 at its elevation: 07 = 0 m, 01 = -10 m, 11 and up = number - 7), and puts each object in its level's storey. Other elements that were in a removed storey go in the building. Writes ePset_LocationTool / Location 0 = level on the objects.
